title: Unit – 5 : Session – 3 : SLO – 2  |  Simulating Pattern Recognition with Input Strings
sections: 1. DFA for "ends in 01" — accepts exactly the strings over {0,1} whose last two symbols are 01, e.g. 01, 001, 101, 1101, 10101. It rejects ε, 0, 1, 00, 10, 11, 100, etc.

2. Simulating input '1010' (DFA ends-in-01, states q0=start/no-match, q1=last symbol 0, q2=accept/ends-01): read 1 → q0; read 0 → q1; read 1 → q2 (accept state); read 0 → q1. String exhausted at q1, which is not accepting → '1010' is REJECTED (it ends in 10, not 01).

3. Testing pattern recognition in code — with automata-lib, run dfa.read_input_stepwise("1010") to trace the state at each symbol, or dfa.accepts_input("1010") for the verdict; a hand-written simulator loops: state = δ(state, symbol) for each character, then checks state ∈ F.
